# Unhandled exceptions during file analysis

The analyze method catches all exceptions when analyzing a file and simply records the reference of the failed file. This could hide underlying issues that need to be addressed, impacting the reliability of the analysis process.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/typescript_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.typescript_analyzer.TypeScriptAnalyzer.analyze`
- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/typescript_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.typescript_analyzer.TypeScriptAnalyzer._analyze_file`
